[WP] A scientific expedition miles underground reveals a vast, uninhabited city. Initial exploration reveals fresh footprints.

It was day 4 of our expedition when we finally tunneled our way in through the caverns. Numerous setbacks had stalled us along the way; cave-ins, equipment malfunctions, and even gas leakages, all against our calculations which had deemed us safe from any natural hazards. In fact, it had almost seemed as if someone was actively interfering.

When we finally broke through, we all breathed a sigh of relief, only to suck in that same sigh a moment later. A gasp was the cause, one instigated by the towering ruins that lay both above and below us. We had drilled out to a ledge, where as far as you could see, a massive cavern dipped down to unfathomable depths, while the roof of the cavern reached hundreds of feet above our heads. And to top it all off, gigantic, primitive buildings stretched the entire expanse.

The buildings were not shaped in any way; rather, they were simply burrows, though advanced ones, dug into the massive pillaring stalactites and stalagmites that decorated the enormous cavern that lay in front of our eyes. It was when we took the time to closer examine these settlements through our binoculars that we noticed the footprints.

They stretched far and wide in every direction, sometimes even vertically on the pillars that made up this city. But what terrified us most was that these footprints were clearly not human, and that the feet to those whom these prints belonged were nowhere to be found.

It was then that we heard the growling behind us.
